messages:
Nina (Content): quick sync We need tight microcopy variants for the tri-mode landing pages plus social captions and a webinar CTA. Goal: ship A/Bable bits to staging today. Deliverables: hero (1 line each), subhead (1 short sentence), 2 social captions, webinar hook + 3 takeaways, and form -> queue routing. Keep language customer-first and testable.

Leo (Growth): Ill take social captions and scheduling. Plan: announce post + 24h reminder with demo CTA. Test headlines: "Save on inference" vs "Predictable latency".

Iris - PMM: Ill do subheads and webinar bullets. Focus on buyer outcomes (developer time to ship, cost predictability, security). No hard numbers yet.

Carlos (Ops): routing rules: prefer company_email detection and compliance flag. If form_has_{compliance:true} -> solutions-eng. Also include utm_campaign and event_id. Draft mapping below.

```
form_type, fields -> route
contact:demo, {company_email, company_size} -> sales-enterprise
signup:trial, {company_email} -> growth-trial-queue
signup:self-serve, {personal_email} -> freemium-onboard
question:compliance, {compliance:true} -> solutions-eng
support:bug, {severity:high} -> eng-oncall
```

Nina (Content): hero drafts (pick one per mode, keep <8 words):
- Hosted: "Fast live inference. Zero infra work."
- Hosted (alt): "Start building with production inference."
- Dedicated: "Reserved GPUs for steady, high-throughput serving."
- Dedicated (alt): "Predictable performance, dedicated capacity."
- Private: "Inference inside your network, audited & private."
- Private (alt): "On-prem and VPC options for regulated apps."

Iris - PMM: subheads (one-liners):
- Hosted: "Turn prototypes into features with predictable latency."
- Dedicated: "Committed capacity and SLA-backed throughput."
- Private: "Control where data runs and who can access it."

Leo (Growth): social captions (2 each):
- Announce A (product-first): "Redwood Inference now on Hosted, Dedicated, and Private modes. Ship LLM features with lower latency and clearer unit costs. See the product -> [link]"
- Announce B (motion-first): "Prod-ready inference for teams who need reliability and control. Join our webinar to see benchmarks and deployment patterns -> [link]"
- Reminder (24h): "Live demo tomorrow. Learn when to use Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private and how to cut cost without sacrificing latency. RSVP -> [link]"

Carlos (Ops): small note 3If company_size > 1000 or form includes enterprise_keyword, auto-assign to senior SDR and flag for immediate follow-up. Use utm_source=webinar_social for these posts.

DeployBot: content push scheduled for 17:30 PT; will deploy to /marketing/staging once assets are uploaded.

Nina (Content): Iris, can you tighten webinar bullets to be buyer-focused and include one practical takeaway each? Leo, please prep social posts with UTMs. Carlos, add the queue names to the routing table in product CRM. Back here in 2 hours for signoff. :clock2:
